# Vendored crates

Patched copies of [tauri-store](https://github.com/ferreira-tb/tauri-store) crates, wired up through
`[patch.crates-io]` in `../Cargo.toml`.

| Crate               | Upstream version |
| ------------------- | ---------------- |
| tauri-store         | 1.2.3            |
| tauri-store-utils   | 0.7.2            |
| tauri-plugin-svelte | 3.2.1            |

Upstream is unmaintained and only supports Tauri 2. The only changes from the published crates are:

- `tauri` / `tauri-plugin` dependencies bumped to the Tauri 3 alpha.
- `permissions/autogenerated/commands` removed (Tauri 3 writes these to `OUT_DIR`).
- `tauri-store` tests, dev-dependencies, `Cargo.lock`, and `Cargo.toml.orig` removed.

Delete this directory and the `[patch.crates-io]` section once the plugin publishes Tauri 3 support or is replaced.
